purpose: Next-trading-day executable simulation for V1.1 EXTENDED research signals; compares entry styles and reports net trade win rate.

executionRules.OPEN_NO_CHASE_3PCT: Buy next open only when it is no more than +3% above signal close.
executionRules.PULLBACK_1PCT: Next-day-only buy limit at 1% below signal close; if opening below limit, fill at open.
executionRules.BREAKOUT_0_5PCT: Next-day-only stop buy at 0.5% above signal-day high; a gap through trigger fills at the open.
executionRules.stop: Higher (tighter) of entry - 1.5 ATR14 and signal low - 0.25 ATR14, using signal-day information only.
executionRules.timeExit: If neither stop nor target occurs, exit at the fifth trading-day close after the signal.
executionRules.sameDayAmbiguity: Daily OHLC cannot order high/low. If stop and target are both touched, STOP is assumed first. For intraday pullback fills, same-day target is ignored because it may have occurred before entry.
executionRules.winRate: Among completed entered trades, percentage with net return > 0 after the stated commission, tax and slippage assumptions.

limitations: Daily OHLC cannot resolve exact intraday path; same-day ambiguity is handled conservatively.
Current security master creates survivorship bias; delisted historical stocks are absent.
Yahoo/yfinance is not official archival exchange data.
The execution rules are standardized research rules, not the final discretionary V3.3 trigger/stop/target for each stock.
No historical fundamentals, catalysts, valuation or point-in-time news are reconstructed here.
